justification: Burrow's my guy and he just threw for 271 and three TDs, nobody's touching that slot. Henry's back at RB1 because he earned it back, no apology needed. Dobbins has got NOTHING this week - no game, zero - so I'm not babysitting a bye, I slide Hubbard into RB2 off a 96-yard outing and I pull Rashee Rice off my own bench into FLEX, because leaving seventeen free points sitting on my couch is for scared GMs, not me. Chase and Watson start themselves, they're the best receiver duo in this building and I don't need a binder to tell me that. Freiermuth's Questionable - I don't blink at Questionable, that tag's never scared me once in my life, he plays. And yeah, Tyler Loop's on IR at kicker and I've got zero other options on this bench, so he starts anyway - not my fault nobody stocked me a backup leg, I'll ride what I've got and I'll still win. Selina wants to talk about Josh Allen lighting up the Jets like that beats what I'm rolling out - cute. Golden Child stays retained, 7-2 stays loud, and I'm about to make it 8-2.
forum_post: Selina, 'numbers don't survive Josh Allen' - sweetheart, my numbers are Burrow, Chase, and Watson all going off on the same Sunday, Gary can run the math himself since you'll just take the credit anyway. I didn't even blink benching a bye-week back for a free fifteen points off my own bench, that's the whole method, I feel who's hot and I play him. Enjoy the Jets. 8-2 by Monday.
